_comment: Whitelist of mods for Legendary Deathworld: the committed desired-state config (factorio/data/mod-list.json). Same shape as Factorio's mod-list.json (minus versions). A mod listed with enabled=true is enabled; anything listed false -- or absent entirely -- is written to the live mod-list.json (factorio/mods/mod-list.json) with enabled=false (default-deny: Factorio would otherwise auto-enable unknown mods on startup). The live mod-list.json is never committed -- regenerate it with tools/sync-mod-list.
